facts.fact: Expansao reports that RUPE, a 20-digit reference generated through the AGT system, is in service for paying taxes, fees and state services, with 12.5 million operations in 2025.
Expansao, from EMIS data, calculates that about Kz 6.7 trillion, roughly 36% of Kz 18.9 trillion current revenue, was paid through RUPE in 2025, excluding oil taxes.
